about_the_game:
Bru & Boegie explode into the follow-up to Episode 1 for their biggest adventure yet in another colourful fully-animated and fully-voiced point and click game, full of irreverent humour and offbeat surrealist comedy.

You are BRU. All you want is some SUGAR for your COFFEE… but someone or something is stealing all of Earth’s sugar! Can you POINT-&-CLICK your way through weird conspiracies and even weirder characters to figure out why? And most importantly - can you GET DA SUGAR for your coffee? Only YOU will determine if you have what it takes! Fortune favours the bald, and now’s your time to shine (your head).

Features:

  • Couldn’t-be-simpler one button gameplay.

  • Make important decisions that could determine the fate of the entire human species!

  • Mini-Games - joy!

  • Another collectathon!

  • A gripping story full on fringe conspiracies and secrets!

  • More than double the length of Episode 1!

  • Full-voiced human cast!

  • More than 1000 lines of dialogue!

  • Meet a buncha weirdos with an even bigger cast than Episode 1.

  • Explore even more of KIFFTOWN.

  • Offbeat non-sequiturs from Bru designed to make you smirk.

  • Learn the true nature of reality!

  • Pick up a cat!

  • Runs on a potato!

All this and more await you in the Bru & Boegie: Episode 2 - Get da SUGAR!

Keep your eyes peeled for the announcement of Episode 3.

  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 LTS or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2nd gen) or AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i3
